resources.string: Opt-in event timeline, up to 2 MiB. Stops after 24 hours or when the process exits. No audio, lyrics, media names, paths or account data. Export a ZIP after reproducing the problem.
Operation failed. Check the file or available capacity and retry.
Import: %1$d · Name conflicts: %2$d · Saved: %3$d/%4$d. Active sound settings will stay as they are until you apply a preset.
Not enough preset slots. Change the conflict policy or remove saved presets.
Strict output leaves hardware and PCM gain unchanged.
No unambiguous writable playback master volume was found. Using digital volume.
Safe handoff requires readable and writable DAC mute control. Using digital volume.
The DAC volume range cannot be safely confirmed. Using digital volume.
The DAC is already muted. Its mute setting is preserved.
DAC control or readback failed. Digital fallback is used when its gain can be confirmed; otherwise playback stops.

Hardware mode supports verified UAC1/UAC2 playback master controls. Switching briefly fades out and in. It never raises DAC gain above its value at connection; device gain is restored on close. Readback does not verify physical loudness.
Hardware changes wait until playback resumes.
The DAC gain or mute was changed outside ECHO. Digital volume is now used and the external setting is preserved. Reopen the output to detect hardware control again.
